sentences.text:
It is the case of the petitioners that they have jointly purchased a piece of commercial land measuring an area of 1.01 acre in R. S. Plot No. 739 and 1 acre in R. S. Plot No. 740, both under R. S.
Khata No. 16 of Mouza - Malti within Namkum Police Station (Thana No. 332) in the district of Ranchi.
The lands were also mutated in favour of the petitioners.
Subsequently a proposal has been made by the respondent no. 4 before the respondent no. 3 for acquisition of different parts of lands appertaining to Plot No. 740, Khata No. 332.

The grievance of the petitioners is that without initiating any land acquisition proceeding, a road was constructed in the land belonging to the petitioners which has prompted the petitioners to approach this court for payment of fair compensation along with the interest thereon.
Mr. Shishir Suman, learned AC to AAG IV appearing for the State has submitted that he has received instruction that the lands were acquired pursuant to a land acquisition proceeding.
He is however not in a position to state as to whether the compensation has been paid or not to the petitioners.

Be that as it may, in such view of the matter, the petitioners are directed to submit a representation before the respondent no. 3 giving in details the lands for which compensation has been claimed within a period of two weeks and if such representation is preferred by the petitioners before the respondent no. 3, he shall pass a speaking and reasoned order within a period of six weeks thereafter.

It goes without saying that if the claim of the petitioners is found to be genuine, necessary steps shall be taken by the respondent no. 3 to extend the compensation amount to the petitioners within a period of four weeks from the date of disposal of his representation.
This writ application stands disposed of.
